name: Hermes Bridge
description: Relays Mattermost slash commands and interactive actions (buttons/menus/dialogs) to the Hermes agent over its outbound WebSocket, keeping Hermes behind NAT.

settings.help_text: Shared secret that must match the value kept by the Hermes host so the command-registry endpoint can be authenticated.
Mattermost user ID of the Hermes bot that should receive plugin WS events (slash commands and interactive actions).
